issue_title: fix(a11y): event footer column headings fail color contrast on the ATA 2027 event page
problem_statement:
fix(a11y): event footer column headings fail color contrast on the ATA 2027 event page

## Why

After the 2026-09-14 release (ata/release `b128f876`), a headless axe-core 4.10.2 run (WCAG 2A/2AA/2.1AA tags) on the live `https://events.allthingsai.org/events/all-things-ai-2027` reports one `color-contrast` violation (impact: serious) on 4 nodes, at both 1440px and 390px:

```
.min-w-\[8rem\]:nth-child(1) > .text-gray-500.mb-3.tracking-wide
.min-w-\[8rem\]:nth-child(2) > .text-gray-500.mb-3.tracking-wide
```

`min-w-[8rem]` is the footer column wrapper in `src/components/event-public-footer.tsx` (~line 209), so these are the event footer's column headings (Conference, Community, Connect, All Things AI), rendered in `text-gray-500` on the footer's background.

This is separate from #2037, whose two labels (PLACE town label, TRACKS outro eyebrow) no longer appear in the results. The same run found no violations on the schedule Grid (#2032) and no `label-content-name-mismatch` on the home directory (#2037).

## Acceptance
- Compute the real composited contrast of the footer column headings on the footer's actual background, for each theme or brand the footer renders on. Include the ATA event theme; don't assume the default tenant.
- Raise the heading colour to the lowest token that clears 4.5:1 while keeping the heading hierarchy. If the footer is themeable, make the fix theme-safe.
- Add a contract test with the composited ratio, in the style of `tests/unit/homepage-accessibility-contract.test.ts`, that fails with the old class.
- Re-run axe on the live 2027 event page at 1440px and 390px after release. Expect 0 `color-contrast` violations from the footer.
- Don't hide the headings or suppress the rule.
